The focal point is a high altar structure situated beneath a grand, gilded dome with frescoes and stained glass windows. The altar area features white marble or stucco columns, decorative carvings, and religious iconography. In the immediate foreground, there are floral arrangements and what appears to be a lower altar table or communion rail. The lighting is dramatic, highlighting the gold leaf and architectural details against shadowed recesses.
